title: Yara and the Letter
author: Coral Ishikawa
blurb: Xanthe Zhou, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
